authority: Vanilla+ world layouts, metatile identities, player coordinates, runtime weather and RTC remain authoritative
fallback: existing R5 indexed two-plane terrain; visible default material when indexed material is unavailable
model_role: optional per-metatile decorative fragment; R5 ground retained underneath
family_policy: source-label/behavior hints only; ambiguous identities stay unclassified, never assigned guessed models
source_status: no verified ORAS environment acquisition or normalized payload at this checkpoint

mobile.instancing: HISM; deterministic row-order admission with R5 fallback for overflow
mobile.hlod: disabled mobile baseline; any generated proxy requires R18 cooked-runtime validation
mobile.performance_status: source budget contract only; no device FPS or memory claim

water.baseline: source R5 water metatiles remain visible
water.optional_shader: cosmetic only; no surf, fishing, current or encounter decisions
water.animation_status: no new animated-water material or source animation import verified

camera.target: read-only core save player coordinates through R5 TileToWorldLocation
camera.interpolation: 1-exp(-speed*dt); snap on map presentation revision including same-map reload
camera.lookahead: disabled until an authoritative motion snapshot is exposed
camera.occlusion: open camera-to-player segment against opt-in render bounds; hide only decorative instance and restore exact transform

lighting.clock: read-only core local RTC; retain last valid visual hour on read failure
lighting.weather: runtime weather IDs; coordinate-event IDs never interpreted as runtime IDs
lighting.unresolved_policy: neutral baseline without advancing or interpreting gameplay cycles
lighting.indoor_and_cave: map-type-specific fixed ambient profile; exterior sun disabled
